source_artifacts.claim: Defines Isp-only hold pad, two Pac-only barriers, platforms, exits, and a bubble shooter started by the hold pad.
Defines 1.4-second Isp FLOAT, 0.6-second Pac STICKY, and immunity after contact.
Pac rebounds only when an airborne, descending contact approaches the bubble from above; otherwise the bubble applies the player-specific effect and is consumed.
Active hold pads open the authored doors and apply their platform effects; leaving an unlatched pad deactivates those effects.
Jumps use grounded/coyote support; FLOAT moves upward; a player can stand on and be carried with the other player.
Hazard contact or falling below the world kills a hero; completion requires both matching exits.
Manual retry recreates the level state and clears input.
Death resets the room after a short wait and increments the retry count.
Isp and Pac use six distinct movement keys; keyup clears held movement and R retries.
Defines the 470-pixel/s jump and 1200-pixel/s² gravity; the nominal jump arc exceeds the 50-pixel step to Pac shelf.

common_mistakes.consequence: Both Pac-blocking barriers close; Pac can be left before the shelf.
common_mistakes.recovery: Isp can return to HOLD to reopen the route; the full-width floor has no authored hazard, so this error does not force a death reset.

single_operator_note: One operator would need to keep Isp on HOLD while moving and jumping Pac, then shift to Isp steering during FLOAT. The two-human baseline roles do not include this attention-switching cost.
